items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson ruled out (ankle injury).
items.implication: Major target vacuum in MIN offense.
items.opportunity: Jordan Addison and other WRs/TE elevated.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off then ruled out (rib injury); Rapoport: rib strain, full eval Monday, can be painful. Was expected to play (hip).
items.why: In-game rib injury after prior hip Q.
items.implication: Target redistribution to remaining SF pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: Deebo Samuel, George Kittle, others up in snaps/targets.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh injury (in-game vs Lions).
items.why: Thigh issue after tackle near goal line; ruled out quickly.
items.implication: Monitor severity for Week 4+; immediate backup work.
items.opportunity: Braelon Allen or committee elevated rest of game/ROS if multi-week.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers is active for season debut vs Saints (knee).
items.why: Expected barring setback after limited practices; Friday DNP planned.
items.implication: Must-start TE if healthy enough for full role.
items.opportunity: High target share in return; Mayer demoted.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs (knee); coach Hafley: initial eval 'does not sound very optimistic' / major concern.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game; coach pessimistic on severity.
items.implication: Significant absence risk beyond Week 3; thin MIA backfield.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is active vs Cowboys after pregame workout; Rapoport notes likely limited usage.
items.why: Pregame workout looked good; team decided to play him.
items.implication: Startable but monitor snaps/usage; late-swap risk reduced.
items.opportunity: Primary WR role if not heavily limited; targets over Bateman.

items.text: If Flowers is active for Baltimore he's active for me; start him over Bateman despite risk.
items.why: Active status overrides prior GTD uncertainty for start decision.
items.implication: Prefer Flowers in lineups over secondary Ravens options.
items.opportunity: Alpha WR usage if snaps hold.

items.text: Actives include Bills WR DJ Moore (shoulder, expected/limited), Keon Coleman; Steelers RB Jaylen Warren; Pittman expected/active (foot). Spears up.
items.implication: Moore limited possible; Warren/Pittman full expected roles.
items.opportunity: Warren dual-threat; Moore if snaps hold; Pittman WR volume.

items.text: Jets WR Adonai Mitchell (finger) expected inactive (was GTD); Levitan depth chart: Wilson, Isaiah Williams, Pritchett, Shepard, McLain; TE Sadiq slot/wide work.
items.why: Finger injury; confirmed inactive per sources.
items.implication: Wilson clear WR1; secondary WRs and Sadiq opportunity.
items.opportunity: Increased routes/targets for Wilson and backups; Sadiq hybrid role.

items.text: ETR had Flowers out in projections early Sunday (hamstring); still possible he plays with late swap for Bateman/Andrews DFS. Team not counting on him initially.
items.why: Limited info; team messaging pessimistic pre-workout.
items.implication: Elevated Bateman/Andrews in early projs; reverse on ACTIVE.

items.text: Sunday AM summary: GTD Flowers (not counting), Spears hopeful; Expected Warren/Pittman/Barkley/Smith/Bowers/Evans/Coker/Coleman; Q Parkinson/Bagent.
Berry highlights Trevor Lawrence kneeling to set up Bhayshul Tuten rushing TD; supporting Tuten fantasy owners.
items.why: Coach/QB intentional goal-line setup for Tuten.

items.text: Love Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop, Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup and prop line support volume.
items.opportunity: High carry/red-zone share vs weak run D.

items.text: Love Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games, RB7 util; PIT allows 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Love Chris Olave (vs LV: 10+ tgts, high aDOT/air yards, LV allows high YPR); Dalton Schultz (@IND: 28% tgt share w/ Collins out, IND soft vs TE); Christian Watson (vs ATL: high util/RZ share).
items.opportunity: Olave volume; Schultz TE1 upside w/ Collins out; Watson RZ.

items.text: Hate Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX: post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches, tough run D); Travis Etienne (vs LV: low util/snaps even w/ Kamara); Terry McLaurin (vs SEA: tough WR D, low team total).
After Stevenson fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led NE backfield 65% snaps and out-touched 16-5 rest of game; gap narrowed but Stevenson still ranked ahead W3.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/touches if fumbles or role change continues.

items.text: With Nico Collins out, Dalton Schultz 28-30% target share / targeted 30% routes; faces IND soft vs TEs.
items.implication: Schultz TE1 streamer while Collins out.
